course_description: This course covers the fundamentals of object-oriented programming and applications using Python programming language. Covers a range of topics in object-oriented including information hiding, polymorphism, method overriding, method overloading, class inheritance, static and dynamic binding, and generic programming. Emphasis is also placed on object-oriented design approaches. This course provides hands-on experience using Python programming language through both individual assignment and group programming projects.
